idea: copied layout: shared sign-groups start a physical line in both documents more often than class-preserving permutations of each document's line starts allow
primary: all LA tablet pairs sharing >= 2 sign-groups (sign-groups on > 30 documents excluded), statistic = shared sign-groups starting a line in both, 20,000 permutations
support_if: P <= 0.01 on all pairs AND z > 0 on pairs with a member published after 1950 AND the planted 25 % copy world is detected (z >= 2 in >= 4 of 5)
kill_if: P > 0.05 on all pairs, or the excess is carried only by two faces of one tablet
lb: LB KN and PY pairs through the same code; entry-initial class preserved, so LB's one-entry-per-line convention gives no excess by construction
